intro: General Marcus Jonathan is the High Commander of Stormwind Defense, stationed directly at the gates in the Valley of Heroes. A veteran of the Second War, he oversees the garrison protecting the capital and manages military requests from the kingdom's frontier settlements.

p: Mounted atop his steed in the Valley of Heroes, General Marcus Jonathan stands as the first line of defense and the highest-ranking military officer overseeing the city gates. He fought in the Second War alongside renowned soldiers like Reginald Windsor under the command of General Turalyon. In this era of rising tension, Jonathan must balance the immediate security of the capital with the increasingly desperate calls for aid from frontier towns like Lakeshire.
